title: Sort Array by Increasing Frequency
summary: Provide an array of integers and sort it by the ascending frequency of its elements.
statement: Provide an array of integers and sort it by the ascending frequency of its elements. When frequencies are equal, order those elements in descending value. Output the sorted array.
constraints: Sort by increasing value frequency; for equal frequencies, sort values in decreasing numeric order.
hints: Frequency is the primary key and negative value encodes the descending tie rule.
Count every value, then sort individual entries by (count,-value).
Build a Counter and use the two-part key for Python’s sort.
Equal values share a key and remain grouped; tuple ordering applies the exact primary and secondary rules.
editorial: Equal values share a key and remain grouped; tuple ordering applies the exact primary and secondary rules.

tests.explanation: Three occurs once, one twice, and two three times, so their groups appear in that frequency order.
All values except one occur twice; the tied groups place three before two.
